Container.Name: LND
Container.Overview: LND is the Lightning Network Daemon, a complete Lightning Network node implementation. This template starts LND on Bitcoin mainnet with the Neutrino light-client backend by default, exposes the Lightning P2P, gRPC, and REST ports, and persists the full /root/.lnd directory. LND can custody real bitcoin; back up the wallet seed and static channel backup before funding channels.
Container.Requires: LND has no web interface. Use lncli inside the container or connect compatible Lightning tools through gRPC/REST with the generated TLS certificate and macaroons from /root/.lnd. For a production routing node, consider editing Post Arguments to use your own Bitcoin Core or btcd backend instead of Neutrino.

Config.Name: LND Data
Config.Description: Persistent LND data, wallet, TLS certificate, macaroons, channel database, logs, and static channel backup.

Config.Name: Lightning P2P Port
Config.Description: Lightning peer-to-peer port. Forward this port from your router if this node should accept inbound public peers.

Config.Name: gRPC API Port
Config.Description: LND gRPC API port. Requires TLS and macaroons.

Config.Name: REST API Port
Config.Description: LND REST API port. Requires TLS and macaroons. Host port defaults to 8081 to avoid common web UI port conflicts.
